name: Thu Khoa Huan statue
nameVi: Tượng đài Thủ Khoa Nguyễn Hữu Huân
kicker: Statue in the old station garden
summary: Stone statue in the old station garden: a few minutes on the evening walk, the pin of the river corner. It stands in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng, where đường 30 Tháng 4 meets Trưng Trắc. The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho rails ended here and stopped in 1958. No passenger train runs.
getThere: On the embankment, at vườn hoa Lạc Hồng
heroCaption: The statue above the garden trees, face and crossed arms in frame

notice.title: The railway stopped in 1958
notice.body: The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho railway stopped in 1958. The station is a memory in this garden.

body: The statue and the garden mark the river corner, at đường 30/4 and đường Trưng Trắc. That was old phường 1. It is now inside phường Mỹ Tho. The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho rails ended in front of vườn hoa Lạc Hồng and this statue. Walk here late in the afternoon, with the embankment.

Nguyễn Hữu Huân is named among the later-19th-century scholars in the town museum. The museum holds that story. The statue is the pin in the garden, and the pedestal carries his name. Give it a few minutes on the walk, then stay with the river.

The electric cart starts and ends on this embankment, at số 01 Hoàng Sa, from 07:00 to 22:00. The planned Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ railway leaves this garden as a memory of the old line. The garden is the stop.

figures.caption: The statue in the garden, with fishing boats on the Tiền behind
figures.alt: The Thủ Khoa Huân statue above the garden, with boats on the river behind the trees

gettingThere: The statue is in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng, on đường 30/4 and đường Trưng Trắc, phường Mỹ Tho. A room on đường 30 Tháng 4 is already on this walk. The tourist pier is on the same embankment, at số 01 Hoàng Sa.

legs.heading: From a room on đường 30 Tháng 4
legs.body: Walk. The garden is the river corner of this street.

legs.heading: From the pier at 01 Hoàng Sa
legs.body: Walk the embankment. The cart also starts here, 07:00–22:00.

admissionNote: The garden has no published ticket. The cart, if you ride it, is a separate fare.
